REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL FOR APPOINTMENT OF A GENERAL SALES AGENT (GSA) FOR PASSENGER SALES OF GULF EXAMPLE AIRWAYS IN OMAN

Gulf Example Airways invites proposals for the appointment of a General Sales Agent (GSA) for passenger sales and ticketing in Oman. Tender reference GEA-PAX-2026-11.

Proposals must be submitted by 20 January 2027 at 16:00 GST.
